evidenceScope: Loaded production extension: Personal Device metadata preview/apply, thumbnail reinsertion, independent readback, no-write repeat and full application restart/readback on one disposable clone. No footprint/model geometry or engineering approval is certified by this metadata test.

environment.versionIdentitySource: Native sys_Environment.getEditorCurrentVersion(true), checked by the typed workflow
environment.transport: Local loopback WebSocket bridge with a controlled MCP stdio client

extension.install: Native Extensions Manager import with external interaction enabled, followed by full application exit and relaunch

fixture.description: Previously created disposable Personal Device clone derived from LCSC C164170, Molex 47219-2001
fixture.privacy: Private library/Device/asset identifiers, image URLs, full native records and local paths are omitted. Raw before/after reports and image bytes are retained locally.

thumbnail.independentReadbackMethod: Fresh LIB_Device.get calls and separate Node HTTPS downloads from the before/after saved native image URLs, followed by SHA-256 and complete byte comparisons

initialCandidate.fix: Resolve AbortController through globalThis; retain the bounded timeout and reject before fetch when unavailable. Regression tests reproduce lexical shadowing and missing global capability.

runtimeAndFailureHandling.cors: Automatic browser fetch succeeded in the loaded Windows extension for this image-pro.easyeda.com fixture before/after upload and after restart. No general CORS claim is made for other origins or hosts.
runtimeAndFailureHandling.redirects: Production fetch uses redirect:error, credentials:omit, no-referrer and no-store; redirect rejection is covered by automated tests, not a deliberately redirected live fixture.
runtimeAndFailureHandling.timeoutAndSize: The 3.5-second abort and 512-KiB streamed-byte ceiling remain enabled. Stalls and oversize responses are automated tests, not induced during live apply.
runtimeAndFailureHandling.unknownOutcomes: The live write was acknowledged and verified. Unknown native acknowledgements and readback failures have automated contract tests; no live ambiguous write was induced. No write retry or rollback was performed.
runtimeAndFailureHandling.disconnectedPreview: A preview during an application restart returned BRIDGE_READ_FAILED with writeOutcome:not_attempted. Testing resumed only after connection and exact dispatcher identity were established.

knownLimitations: One disposable Personal Device with one existing JPEG was tested. PNG thumbnails and supported LCSC image paths have automated coverage, not live evidence in this run.
The live test used the local dev tool profile. Default-profile availability and remote scopes/approval contracts are covered separately by repository tests; remote relay was not exercised.
Observable references and transforms were preserved; referenced symbol/footprint/model geometry and hidden native asset data were not independently revalidated by this metadata test.
Native preflight and modify are not an atomic compare-and-swap. This test does not certify behavior under all external concurrent edits.
This evidence does not establish manufacturing, electrical, supplier or design-level approval. Caller-supplied review statements require separate engineering evidence.
